title: Boolean and decision logic

operators.name: AND — mandatory conjunction
operators.definition: Use `AND` when all conditions are necessary. A failed mandatory condition blocks publication or sends the candidate to research.
operators.example:
PUBLISH
IF demand_is_evidenced
AND intent_is_distinct
AND business_fit_is_positive
AND information_advantage_exists
AND asset_is_maintainable
AND measurement_is_installed

operators.name: OR — valid alternatives
operators.definition: Use `OR` when several different forms can satisfy the same requirement. `OR` does not mean “include everything.” It means choose one or more valid alternatives according to the task.
operators.example:
EVIDENCE
=
firsthand_experience
OR original_data
OR reproducible_test
OR qualified_expert_review
OR documented_case_study

operators.name: XOR — exactly one
operators.definition: Use `XOR` when only one choice can be canonical.
operators.example:
FOR EACH dominant_intent_cluster:
    existing_url XOR new_url XOR merged_url
    MUST be the intended canonical destination

operators.name: NOT — explicit exclusion
operators.example:
TARGET_CLUSTER
=
candidate_queries
NOT jobs
NOT salaries
NOT unrelated_brand
NOT wrong_geography
NOT wrong_language

operators.name: IF / THEN / ELSE — branching decision
operators.example:
IF same_task
AND same_answer_structure
AND same_result_format
AND same_next_action
THEN merge_into_one_canonical_asset
ELSE split_or_test

operators.name: FOR EACH — controlled scale
operators.definition: This creates candidates, not automatic publication.
operators.example:
FOR EACH approved_location
AND FOR EACH approved_service
GENERATE candidate_location_service_page

operators.name: UNTIL — optimization loop
operators.example:
REPEAT diagnose → change → observe → decide
UNTIL:
    target_is_reached
    OR expected_value_falls_below_cost
    OR constraint_is_triggered

operators.name: AT LEAST / AT MOST / EXACTLY
operators.example:
AT_LEAST 1 useful internal link points to every priority canonical page
AT_MOST 1 dominant intent owns a canonical URL
EXACTLY 1 primary KPI governs an experiment

semantics: THEN     specifies the action when the condition is true.
ELSE     specifies the valid fallback when the condition is false.
OR       permits one or more valid alternatives.
NOT      excludes a state or candidate.
UNTIL    establishes a bounded feedback loop.
EXACTLY_ONE assigns unique ownership or a single decision.
precedence_note: Rules conflict. Resolve them in this order, highest first.
hard_gate_pattern:
IF all mandatory conditions pass
THEN execute or advance the candidate
ELSE route to research, consolidation, repair, deferral, or rejection
